evidence: The PR moved the rank-inversion count to the whole unfiltered queue, but the renderer still returned on `len(issues) == 0` before `printRankInversions`, so a filter that left zero rows dropped the warning entirely. The agent deleted the early return so the empty path falls through to the unconditional tail, added the zero-row test case, and mutation-checked it. The 7804f8f CHANGELOG now records the empty-view case.
guidance_note: When moving a derivation upstream of a filter so it covers the whole population, trace every early return in each consumer of that derivation, including the empty-view path, before claiming the fact survives every narrowing.

evidence: The agent confirmed `Selects` rejects Archived/Deleted unless IncludeArchived/IncludeDeleted are set, so the zero value selects everything live, not everything. The comment was qualified. narrative: Round 0 raised three real defects (an empty-view early return that dropped the warning, a benchmark using synthetic testing.T values, an under-covering citation). All three were fixed correctly in f4a241e, and round 1 approved. The agent then added substantial new work (7804f8f, ID batching for the O(N^2) IN-clause planning cost, plus a citation line-shift and a consistency comment). Rounds 2-4 reviewed that new scope and found a misplaced doc comment, incomplete batching coverage contradicting its own comment, and two pre-existing doc inaccuracies. None of the findings came from a fix for an earlier finding. Round 5 hit the MAX_REVIEW_ROUNDS cap, so the final fixes (afe709b, d634b09, 342b651, 91a5037) were never reviewed.
guidance_observations: Expanding the PR's scope after an approval (the perf batching in 7804f8f) cost three more review rounds and pushed the last four fix commits past the five-round cap, so they merged unreviewed.

Several fixes landed after more review rounds had already run on unrelated pushes (F4 was raised in round 2 and fixed after round 4), which spent rounds on heads that still carried known open findings.
The agent's replies verified each premise against the code and reproduced or mutation-checked before fixing, and none of its fixes produced a follow-up finding.
